metadata.title: Reference-Relative Recovery and the Budget × Depth Boundary

story.iWant: the recovery criterion to be able to measure the venue against the market price rather than par
story.soThat: the surface shows where the attack beats the defense, and the budget-vs-depth hypothesis (F-11) is tested
story.tasks: - Criterion option (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Reference-criterion surface (AC: 4) - Budget × depth (AC: 5) - Headline, ADR, close out (AC: 6, 7, 8, 9)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–9. The Protocol-view design in AC 1 and Dev Notes is normative unless it conflicts with ADR-0007, in which case propose the amendment.

docs.doc: Why the criterion changes and what to test.

existing.reason: Add reference field with default par.

story-context.constraints: - Kernel imports no protocol/ module; views only. PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1. - Default reference = par; every scenario hash unchanged; run-vs-rerun fixtures untouched. - usdc-2023.yaml unchanged (hash 2c3aeaa9825d). - Charts read mc.parquet + manifest only. - No hand-tuned axes; predictions in Dev Notes are checked, not enforced. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: published_price: float | None (Oracle alias of price; reference_price keeps its 1.5 meaning)

tests.standards: pytest; termination tests with a stub PegView/ReferenceView registered in a RunContext (manual phases per 1.3); synthetic mc.parquet for plot_budget_depth; hash test over scenarios/.
